description: No RSS/Atom feed was observed on the Banka Slovenije announcements hub (https://www.bsi.si/sl/mediji/objave). The page offers only category filters and an email newsletter subscription.

result.result_summary: Direct fetch of the listing rendered categories and items but exposed no feed URL.

why_it_matters: Collection must rely on HTML crawling and diffing rather than a feed, raising fragility and cost; an email-newsletter subscription may be a cheaper change trigger.

description: https://www.a-tvp.si/nadzorovani-subjekti-/javne-druzbe returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain fetch, while the page is clearly indexed and linked.

result.result_summary: 403 on one attempt; treated as bot-defended-but-live hypothesis, NOT as dead.

why_it_matters: The whole a-tvp.si domain (issuer lists, enforcement, prospectuses) may need a headless browser or realistic UA/headers; a naive collector would wrongly mark these critical registers as dead.

description: The OAM (Officially Appointed Mechanism) repository of issuers' regulated information was referenced by ATVP-derived search results as www.oam.si, but I did not fetch it in this pass and did not confirm its search interface or whether it is served under a different host/path.

result.result_summary: Referenced, not opened.

why_it_matters: OAM is potentially the single highest-value endpoint for annual/half-year reports of Slovenian issuers; its exact address and query interface must be confirmed before it is relied on.

description: I did not locate a dedicated, dated press-release index for AZN comparable to BS's /mediji/objave; the closest observed is 'Stališča in obvestila Agencije' plus the annual reports archive.

result.result_summary: Searched in Slovenian; only notices and annual-report pages surfaced.

why_it_matters: Insurance-supervisor news flow may need to be captured via the notices page and the WordPress uploads directory rather than a proper newsroom.

description: English-language searching surfaced only mirrored bsi.si/en pages; no English-language equivalents were found for ATVP or AZN registers and enforcement pages in this pass.

result.result_summary: en queries returned bsi.si/en publication, statistics and supervisory-disclosure pages plus Wikipedia; nothing new for ATVP/AZN.

why_it_matters: Confirms that Slovenian-language collection is mandatory for the securities and insurance supervisors; an English-only pipeline would miss most of this cell.

description: No public, documented REST/JSON API or RSS feed for SEOnet announcements was found in this pass. Searches in Slovene for an RSS/subscription channel returned only issuer instructions and unrelated RSS-software results.

result.result_summary: SEOnet appears to be an ASPX web application (default.aspx / default_en.aspx?doc_id=NNNNN) with an announcement archive; ingestion will likely require HTML crawling unless an undocumented feed exists.

why_it_matters: Determines whether A1 disclosure ingestion for Slovenia is a cheap feed subscription or a maintained scraper with breakage risk.

description: AJPES JOLP free public access is documented as rate-limited (search-result text describes a daily cap of around 20 business entities per user account) and free viewing covers only the last five business years.

result.result_summary: Bulk annual-report harvesting via the free JOLP interface is not viable at portfolio scale; historical depth beyond five years reportedly requires AJPES offices.

why_it_matters: Forces either a paid FI-PO/ponovna-uporaba contract or a narrowly targeted entity list; naive crawling would breach the service and produce gaps.

description: The OAM register (www.oam.si) is referenced by ATVP as the free public register of issuers' audited annual and semi-annual reports, but was not fetched or confirmed in this pass.

result.result_summary: Recorded as a candidate with low confidence and blocker_type=unverified rather than as a confirmed source.

why_it_matters: If live, it may be a better-structured alternative to SEOnet for regulated filings; if defunct or merged into SEOnet/INFO HRAMBA, the pipeline design changes.

description: No distinct Slovene term was found for a machine-readable 'regulated information feed' as a product; the domestic vocabulary is 'nadzorovane informacije', 'objave izdajateljev' and 'INFO hramba', which describe the legal artefact and the storage mechanism rather than a data feed.

result.result_summary: Local-language searching was performed throughout and produced the authoritative hits; the gap is terminological, not coverage.

why_it_matters: Future query design should use artefact and mechanism names, not API/feed vocabulary, when searching Slovenian sources.

description: AJPES data re-use (PRS web services, FI-PO/proFI-PO) is tariff-based; the specific price points for a market-intelligence use case were not retrieved, only the existence of the Cenik storitev and new tariffs.

result.result_summary: Cost of the only scalable legal route to Slovenian annual-report financials is unquantified.

why_it_matters: Budget and build-vs-buy decision for the Slovenian A1 leg cannot be closed without it.

description: Emerging Europe (emerging-europe.com), named explicitly in the coverage cell, did not surface a single Slovenia banking or payments article across two targeted searches; results returned other outlets instead.

result.result_summary: No Emerging Europe Slovenia banking/payments URL found in this pass. Treat as unverified rather than absent — the outlet exists and may cover Slovenia sporadically, but no evidence of a usable Slovenian banking stream was obtained.

why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes Emerging Europe is part of the translation/aggregation layer for Slovenia; if its Slovenian banking output is thin, the layer rests more heavily on SeeNews, bne IntelliNews and STA.

description: No Reuters article on Slovenian banking surfaced directly in search results despite Reuters being named in the cell scope; only third-party references and aggregator restatements appeared.

result.result_summary: Reuters recorded as a candidate on general grounds only, with confidence lowered accordingly and no example URL beyond the homepage.

why_it_matters: Reuters items are usually the reference English version of an event; being unable to locate them via general search means the collection design must use a licensed feed or on-site search rather than open web discovery.

description: Bloomberg, SeeNews, bne IntelliNews, STA wire and the Payment Yearbooks all gate their substantive content; only headlines and ledes are openly retrievable.

result.result_summary: The English translation/aggregation layer for Slovenia is predominantly commercial. Free open-web English coverage is limited to The Slovenia Times, Total Slovenia News, issuer IR pages, SEOnet, Investegate and bsi.si/en.

why_it_matters: A monitoring design that relies only on free sources will see event headlines but not the detail; budget for at least one regional wire subscription (SeeNews or bne) if depth is required.

description: The Ljubljana Stock Exchange SEOnet portal states that only the Slovene text of an announcement has legal value; the English interface is a convenience rendering.

result.result_summary: English versions of Slovenian regulated disclosures are non-authoritative by construction.

why_it_matters: Any analytic claim resting on an English disclosure must be traceable to the Slovenian original; English-only collection is structurally insufficient for the disclosures topic.

description: Beyond NLB, English-language IR/translated-release infrastructure for other Slovenian financial institutions (Nova KBM/OTP Slovenija, SKB, Gorenjska Banka, Sparkasse, Delavska hranilnica, Addiko Bank Slovenija, Bankart) was not individually confirmed in this pass.

result.result_summary: Only NLB was verified to maintain a full parallel English press-release and investor-news stream; the others were seen only through third-party English coverage.

why_it_matters: If non-NLB issuers publish only in Slovenian, the English layer for them is entirely dependent on SeeNews/bne/STA, which makes those aggregators load-bearing rather than merely convenient.

description: No Big Four Slovenia publication dedicated to Slovenian banking or payments was found. Searches in Slovenian for 'Deloitte KPMG EY PwC Slovenija bančništvo raziskava plačilni sistemi' returned only generic service pages, firm directory entries and KPMG transparency reports from 2015/2016.

result.result_summary: Slovenia-specific Big Four banking/payments studies appear not to exist as standalone local publications; Slovenia is covered only as a country line inside regional (CEE) studies.

why_it_matters: Coverage of consultancy views on Slovenian banking must be built from regional CEE studies (Deloitte CEE Banking M&A, Raiffeisen CEE Banking Sector Report) rather than local outputs; expectations of local deliverables should be reset.

description: Full-text credit opinions and BICRA reports from Moody's, S&P and Fitch on Slovenian banks are behind subscription platforms (Moody's.com login, RatingsDirect, Fitch account).

result.result_summary: Only headlines, rating grades and outlooks are freely observable; report bodies are not.

why_it_matters: The cell's highest-value forward-looking content is licensable, not scrapable. A budget/licensing decision, or systematic reliance on issuer IR mirrors and newswires, is required.

description: A Fitch Ratings entity page for Slovenian issuers could not be confirmed from search results; the URL recorded in the candidate list is an inferred pattern, not an observed link.

result.result_summary: Fitch coverage of Slovenian banks is well evidenced through media and issuer statements, but no verified Fitch-hosted landing URL was obtained in this pass.

why_it_matters: Downstream verification must resolve the correct Fitch entity/issuer URLs before the source is treated as collectable; failure to fetch should not be read as absence.

description: No established Slovenian-language term was found for 'transparency exercise' or 'supervisory banking statistics'; Slovenian coverage of EBA/ECB datasets appears to use the English names untranslated.

result.result_summary: Local-language querying for these EU datasets yields no distinct sl vocabulary to exploit.

why_it_matters: For EU supervisory datasets, English-only querying is adequate and sl querying adds no recall — but this must be documented rather than silently assumed.

description: No public list of equity analysts covering NLB (the only listed Slovenian bank, LSE GDR + Ljubljana) with their target prices was located in this pass; searches surfaced only Raiffeisen's sector report.

result.result_summary: Analyst-coverage metadata for NLB was not found openly.

why_it_matters: Sell-side consensus is a valuable forward-looking signal; a follow-up should check NLB's own IR site for an 'analyst coverage' page, which many listed banks publish.

description: Bankart's careers page indicated no open vacancies at the time of search, although archived individual role pages (e.g. business analyst for payment-instrument processing IT services) exist.

result.result_summary: Vacancy pages for a key actor can be empty at any given moment; a single check produces a false 'no activity' read.

why_it_matters: This cell's value depends on continuous time-series capture, not point-in-time snapshots. Empty today does not mean quiet.

description: Local-language queries containing 'razvojna banka' / 'banka' returned heavy noise from non-Slovenian institutions (Bosnian, Bulgarian development banks) and Wikipedia articles rather than SI job ads.

result.result_summary: Generic 'banka' terms are noisy across the ex-Yugoslav language space; queries must be pinned with SI-specific tokens (prosta delovna mesta, d.d., Ljubljana, .si domains).

why_it_matters: Untuned local-language queries waste collection budget and can pull cross-border results into a SI-scoped dataset.

description: LinkedIn (job search and company pages) is the richest source for named tech stacks and headcount build-out but is behind a login wall and its ToS prohibits automated collection.

result.result_summary: Unauthenticated LinkedIn shows only partial listings; no compliant automated pipeline exists without a licensed data feed.

why_it_matters: The highest-signal source in this cell cannot be scraped; it needs either manual analyst review or a paid/licensed labour-market data provider.

description: No dedicated careers/vacancy URLs were confirmed in this pass for several relevant SI actors: Addiko Bank Slovenija, Gorenjska banka, Delavska hranilnica, Sberbank-successor entities, Banka Slovenije (central bank), and domestic fintechs/e-money issuers (e.g. mBills, Flik participants).

result.result_summary: Actor map is incomplete; these were named or implied in results but their own hiring pages were not located.

why_it_matters: Missing mid-tier banks and the central bank leaves a hole exactly where quieter modernisation programmes tend to sit.

description: No Slovenian-language equivalents were found in this pass for vendor/programme jargon that job ads typically carry in English ('core banking migration', 'instant payments', 'ISO 20022', 'PSD2/PSD3 readiness'); SI ads appear to use the English terms verbatim.

result.result_summary: English-in-Slovenian is the working register for bank IT ads; SL-only queries will under-recall technical roles.

why_it_matters: Query design must mix SL job-ad framing words with English technical tokens, or half the signal is invisible.

description: Job ads on SI portals and employer sites expire and are deleted, and no public archive of expired SI bank vacancies was identified.

result.result_summary: Signal is perishable; nothing found reconstructs historical hiring after the fact.

why_it_matters: Without own-archiving at discovery time, no trend analysis of headcount/skill shifts is possible retrospectively.

description: The seed query assumed an event named 'Dnevi slovenskih bančnikov' (plural 'Days'). Slovenian sources consistently show the singular 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov' (Slovenian Bankers' Day), an annual ZBS event, alongside a separate spring 'bančna konferenca'. No source found uses the plural form.

result.result_summary: Correct local-language term is 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov'; queries using the plural return unrelated events (Finančni dnevi, Kapitalski dnevi, Dnevi slovenske informatike).

why_it_matters: Downstream collection keyed on the wrong event name would miss the single most important gathering in this cell and pull in unrelated accountancy conferences.

description: No evidence was found that Bankart (the national card/ATM processor, NLB Group) runs or publishes its own conference, user-group meeting or presentation archive. Searches combining Bankart with konferenca/posvet/dogodek returned only the company's own product pages and unrelated Portorož conferences.

result.result_summary: Bankart appears to speak at third-party events (ZBS posvet o kartičnem poslovanju is the likely venue) rather than hosting an indexed event archive of its own.

why_it_matters: The domestic processor's roadmap statements must be sought inside ZBS posvet agendas and regional events (Money Motion), not on bankart.si.

description: No public slide-deck / presentation archive was located for any Slovenian banking conference in this pass. ZBS posvet pages appear to expose agendas and registration but not downloadable decks; DSI publishes a 'zbornik' (proceedings) which is the closest equivalent.

result.result_summary: Presentation content is largely non-public; recordings (ZBS YouTube) and proceedings (DSI zbornik) are the viable substitutes.

why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed slide decks would be obtainable; collection design should instead prioritise agendas, speaker lists, video and proceedings.

description: No Slovenian 'bančnik leta' (banker of the year) award run by ZBS or the Bank of Slovenia was found. The closest personal recognitions are the general 'Manager leta' award (Združenje Manager) and Bank of Slovenia research awards.

result.result_summary: Person-level banking awards in Slovenia appear to be general management awards, not sector-specific.

why_it_matters: Avoids building a collector for an award that does not exist; redirects attention to institution-level awards (Moje finance, WEBSI, Global Finance, Euromoney).

description: The Bančni vestnik archive is behind a login ('Prijava') at bv.zbs-giz.si and info.zbs-giz.si/bvarhiv, though individual PDFs (notably the English special issues) are directly linked and reachable. Not treated as dead — treated as partially gated.

result.result_summary: Full-text archive requires subscription; bibliography indexes and some PDFs appear open.

why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decision needed if conference papers in Bančni vestnik are to be systematically collected.

description: The canonical Sibos agenda/session-archive URL (sibos.com) was not directly confirmed in this pass; the Sibos entry is recorded from category knowledge plus third-party coverage, with a Wikipedia URL as placeholder rather than an invented agenda link.

result.result_summary: Sibos is included at low confidence and low priority pending a verification pass.

why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated URL entering the registry while preserving the lead.

description: The GZS and Bizi event-calendar root URLs (gzs.si/Dogodki/, bizi.si/dogodki/) are inferred from the deep event URLs actually returned by search; only the deep URLs were observed. Flagged so the verification pass checks the roots rather than assuming them.

result.result_summary: Deep event URLs observed; index roots inferred, not observed.

why_it_matters: Root URLs drive the crawl seed list; an inferred root that 404s would silently disable a collector.

description: No dedicated press release or corporate announcement from Tuš (Engrotuš) about introducing a new payment acceptance method or in-app payment was found in either Slovenian or English searches.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only loyalty-programme descriptions and third-party market overviews; the retailer's own newsroom path was not surfaced.

why_it_matters: Leaves a gap in grocery-acceptance coverage for the third-largest chain, so acceptance events at Tuš may be detected only via national media rather than at source.

description: The seed term 'PS Moneta' did not resolve to any current Pošta Slovenije payment product in search results.

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced 'denarne storitve' and annual reports but nothing named Moneta at Pošta Slovenije; 'Moneta' historically denotes a Mobitel/Telekom carrier-billing brand, not a postal product.

why_it_matters: Using 'PS Moneta' as a standing query term would produce false negatives; the correct local terms for postal payment coverage are 'denarne storitve' and 'plačilni promet', and Moneta queries should be aimed at Telekom Slovenije instead.

description: No DARS (motorway operator) source on e-vignette or toll payment-instrument changes was surfaced despite an explicit Slovenian-language query.

result.result_summary: The parking/toll query returned only EasyPark and municipal parking results; no dars.si or evinjeta.dars.si material appeared.

why_it_matters: Tolling and e-vignette sales are a very large recurring card-acceptance channel in Slovenia and are currently uncovered in this cell.

description: No Slovenian-language source was found for mimovrste=) (a leading Slovenian online retailer) regarding payment-provider integration or new payment methods.

result.result_summary: The e-commerce PSP query returned Big Bang material and generic EU guidance instead; mimovrste's own newsroom or payment pages did not surface.

why_it_matters: mimovrste is one of the highest-volume domestic e-commerce merchants; missing it weakens acceptance-side coverage of online payments.

description: The Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije primary domain (tzslo.si) and the AJPES JOLP annual-report entry point were inferred from organisational knowledge rather than confirmed by a fetch in this pass.

result.result_summary: Search returned only third-party profiles (Bizi, Facebook, media tag pages) for the chamber; AJPES did not appear in any result set for the queries run.

why_it_matters: Both are load-bearing pointer sources for this cell; their exact entry URLs must be confirmed by the deterministic liveness pass before being wired into collection.

description: Slovenia appears to have no dedicated statutory banking ombudsman (a 'bančni varuh'). Searches in Slovene surfaced only the ZBS-run IRPS ADR scheme and Banka Slovenije's supervisory complaint channel; the Human Rights Ombudsman is generalist and archive material discusses proposals for sectoral ombudsmen rather than an existing one.

result.result_summary: ADR for banking disputes is industry-run (ZBS) and its opinions are reportedly non-binding on banks, which limits the enforcement weight of that channel's outputs.

why_it_matters: Complaint-outcome data is therefore fragmented across ZBS, Banka Slovenije and courts; no single authoritative complaints register exists to track institution-level failure rates.

description: IP-RS inspection decisions (inšpekcijske odločbe) in the data-protection field are reportedly not routinely published on the DPA website due to sensitivity, despite being among the most-requested FOI items.

result.result_summary: No public register of named DPA enforcement decisions against Slovenian banks/PSPs was found; only opinions (mnenja) and an OPSI 'praksa' dataset were located.

why_it_matters: Institution-level DPA enforcement against banks will require FOI (ZDIJZ) requests or third-party aggregators, so automated monitoring alone will under-count enforcement events.

description: The cell brief names 'AVP/court rulings'. In Slovenia AVP is the Agencija za varnost prometa (road-traffic safety agency), which has no banking or payments remit; no financial-sector body with that acronym was found.

result.result_summary: Treated as a brief error; substituted the actual court-ruling sources (sodnapraksa.si, sodisce.si) and the actual sectoral supervisors (Banka Slovenije, AZN, ATVP).

why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated or misdirected source entry and corrects the actor map for downstream runs.

description: No centralised Slovenian outage/incident register for payment systems was found. Outage evidence is scattered across per-bank 'obvestila za stranke' pages and news reports; Bankart does not appear to publish a public status page.

result.result_summary: Outage tracking must be assembled from many per-institution pages plus media monitoring.

why_it_matters: Correlating multi-bank outages to shared processors (Bankart) will depend on inference from timestamps rather than an authoritative feed.

description: No English-language equivalent was found for most Slovene complaint/fraud sources; ZBS's ADR page has an /en/ path but consumer-protection, police and DPA material is Slovene-only.

result.result_summary: English-only collection would miss essentially the entire cell.

why_it_matters: Confirms that Slovene-language crawling and keyword lists are mandatory for this cell, not optional.

description: No RSS/Atom feed was observed on the NLB Group press-release or investor-news listings; the pages use a year filter plus a 'Show more' pagination control.

result.result_summary: Collection must rely on scheduled HTML polling and pagination handling rather than a feed subscription.

why_it_matters: Raises collection cost and latency risk for the highest-value announcement stream; a missed poll can silently skip a disclosure.

description: The specific London Stock Exchange instrument/news page for NLB's GDR line (symbol NLB) was not resolved to an exact URL in this pass; only the LSE root and a third-party Investegate announcement were confirmed as leads.

result.result_summary: GDR-side RNS stream identified conceptually and via a mirror, but no confirmed canonical LSE URL.

why_it_matters: The UK-regulated feed carries TR-1 major-holdings notices and ATA notices that may not appear on nlbgroup.com; leaving it unresolved risks a disclosure blind spot.

description: SEOnet (seonet.ljse.si) was identified as the statutory disclosure venue but its NLB-specific issuer announcement listing URL was not captured; the site is an ASP.NET application with form-driven filtering and file.aspx?AttachmentID= downloads.

result.result_summary: Confirmed as the authoritative venue; per-issuer deep link and scrape mechanics still to be worked out.

why_it_matters: SEOnet is the legally authoritative record; a collector that cannot filter by issuer will either over-collect the whole market or miss NLB filings.

description: No public archive of NLB earnings-call transcripts (as text) was located; the event pages point to webcasts/replays rather than transcripts.

result.result_summary: Q&A content appears to exist only as audio/video, not searchable text.

why_it_matters: Management Q&A is where unscripted IT/vendor/integration detail surfaces; without transcripts this requires ASR processing rather than text collection.

description: Slovenian securities regulator ATVP and the central securities depository KDD were noted as adjacent official disclosure actors but were not searched in this cell, since this cell is scoped to NLB's own IR machine.

result.result_summary: Deliberately not covered here; flagged so another cell can pick them up.

why_it_matters: ATVP/KDD hold takeover-bid filings and shareholder-register data that complement issuer self-disclosure.

description: Searched in Slovenian for investor-relations pages ('odnosi z vlagatelji', 'za vlagatelje') for the foreign-owned subsidiaries in this cell — OTP banka SI, Intesa Sanpaolo Bank, UniCredit Banka Slovenija, Addiko SI, Sparkasse, Gorenjska banka.

result.result_summary: None of them operates an IR page in the listed-issuer sense. Their disclosure surface is a documents/reports page plus a press room. Only Delavska hranilnica and DBS maintain investor-style sections, because they have dispersed domestic shareholders / listed debt.

why_it_matters: Collection design must not assume IR pages, earnings calls, or transcripts for this cell. Cadence is annual (report) + episodic (press), with the exception of UniCredit SI's quarterly razkritja and Addiko's listed parent.

description: Checked SKB banka d.d. Ljubljana against the Bank of Slovenia supervised-entity register.

result.result_summary: SKB was removed from the register on 22.8.2024 following its merger into OTP banka d.d. The skb.si PDF archive still resolves in search results but is a legacy asset with no new filings.

why_it_matters: Tracking SKB as a live source will yield permanent silence and may be misread as a dead-site failure. It should be archived once and reclassified as historical; forward coverage rolls into OTP banka d.d.

description: Searched specifically for a standalone Pillar 3 / CRR Part 8 document for SKB banka and for Gorenjska banka in Slovenian ('razkritja', 'razkritja dodatnih informacij').

result.result_summary: For SKB no separate Pillar 3 PDF surfaced — disclosures appear folded into the annual report. For Gorenjska banka a 'dodatna-razkritja' PDF exists but the search result was an older (2021-path) file; the current-year equivalent was not directly observed.

why_it_matters: Pillar 3 granularity varies by issuer in this cell; a uniform Pillar-3-first collection rule would fail. Some banks require parsing the annual report to reach the same tables.

description: Deželna banka Slovenije and Delavska hranilnica each returned two parallel URL generations/domains for the same content (dbs.si /o-nas/ vs /o-banki/; dh.si vs delavska-hranilnica.si).

result.result_summary: Both variants appear in current search results; which is canonical was not determined and is not claimed here.

why_it_matters: Collectors keyed to the non-canonical path risk silent 404s that look like source death. Canonicalisation should be resolved in the deterministic verification pass, not assumed.

description: The cell rationale predicts these private/foreign-owned banks bypass public procurement portals; no attempt within this workstream (A1) surfaced any tender-portal presence for them.

result.result_summary: No public tender surface identified for any bank in this cell; vendor/technology signals must be inferred from press releases, annual report narrative sections, and parent-group presentations.

why_it_matters: Confirms that press rooms and annual reports carry disproportionate weight for this cell and should be collected in full text, not just headline metrics.

description: Searches for Slovenia-specific press releases from Nexi (Nexi Slovenija d.o.o.) returned only company-register and credit-rating aggregator pages — no Slovenian-language corporate newsroom for the local entity surfaced.

result.result_summary: Nexi Slovenija appears to have no local press channel; announcements presumably flow only through Nexi Group (Italy) in English.

why_it_matters: Slovenia-specific processing wins or restructurings at the second-largest local processor may be invisible unless group IR is monitored with full-text country filtering, or AJPES filings are read annually.

description: No Slovenian-language Mastercard or Visa press release / newsroom page was located despite a local-language query using 'sporočilo za javnost'. Results were dominated by Slovenian banks' card terms and consumer FAQ pages.

result.result_summary: Card scheme country announcements for Slovenia were not found on a local newsroom in this pass.

why_it_matters: The cell brief expects card scheme country announcements; if none exist locally, coverage must be achieved via the schemes' global newsrooms with Slovenia keyword filters, which is lower-recall.

description: Bankart's 'Aktualno' newsroom lists only five items spanning 2020-2026, with no visible pagination or archive, and one item is titled generically 'SPOROČILO ZA JAVNOST' (26.3.2025).

result.result_summary: Official Bankart announcement volume is very low (roughly 1-2 items per year).

why_it_matters: The processor at the centre of this cell does not use press releases as its main disclosure channel — annual reports, scheme rulebooks and merchant documentation carry far more signal, and the collection design must weight them accordingly.

description: Bankart annual reports and payment-system public disclosure documents were found only as direct wp-content PDF URLs surfaced by search engines; they are not linked from the current site navigation.

result.result_summary: No stable annual-report index page on bankart.si was identified.

why_it_matters: A crawler following site navigation alone would miss the single richest quantitative source in this cell; discovery must combine sitemap/upload-path enumeration with AJPES.

description: Several URLs in this slice were assembled from search-result snippets rather than fetched in this pass (Nexi Group media index, Mastercard SI root, flik.si root, ECB TIPS index, EPC register, ZBS root, AJPES root, BSI National Payments Council index).

result.result_summary: URLs are provided with confidence scores but liveness is explicitly not asserted.

why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic verification pass must resolve these; a 403 or timeout on any of them should be treated as bot defence, not as a dead source.

description: The Bank of Slovenia 'Poročilo o plačilnih in poravnalnih sistemih' 2021 edition was found on a third-party mirror (findinfo.si) rather than at a canonical bsi.si permalink.

result.result_summary: Canonical publication landing page for this annual report series was not pinned down.

why_it_matters: Long-term monitoring needs the canonical bsi.si index; relying on a mirror risks silent breakage and version ambiguity.

description: No dedicated Slovenian-language newsroom or press-release archive was located for mBills (the Slovenian mobile-wallet/mobile-payments product). Searches returned no company news channel for it.

result.result_summary: Slovenian-language search combining mBills with Leanpay and Paywiser returned nothing on mBills; it may only be covered via its parent/bank-partner channels.

why_it_matters: The domestic mobile-wallet segment is a core part of this cell; without a direct channel it must be tracked indirectly via its owning entity's disclosures and national media, which delays signal.

description: No Slovenia-specific structured funding-round database (rounds, amounts, investors) for fintech/payments startups was found in either language during this pass.

result.result_summary: startup.si offers an investment-tagged news stream and an investor directory, but not a structured round-level dataset; searches surfaced only journalistic rankings of best-funded startups.

why_it_matters: Funding rounds are the primary disclosure channel for unlicensed wallet/BNPL startups; without a structured source, round tracking depends on media monitoring with unknown recall.

description: A directly linked, standalone ATVP page listing MiCA/CASP authorisations for Slovenia was not confirmed; results pointed to ATVP's investment-services register, ATVP MiCA guidance material, and the ESMA interim/central register accessed via ATVP.

result.result_summary: Slovenian-language search for the ATVP crypto register returned the investment-services register and a MiCA leaflet PDF, plus media reporting that 24 providers may operate in Slovenia and that ATVP issued its first MiCA licence.

why_it_matters: The Slovenian CASP population must currently be derived from the ESMA register filtered to SI rather than a national list, adding a dependency and possible lag.

description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all URLs come from search-result metadata and site-structure inference and are supplied with confidence scores only.

result.result_summary: Discovery pass was search-driven; deterministic verification is left to the downstream pass.

why_it_matters: Some deep paths (e.g. section index URLs assembled from article URLs) may redirect or 404 and should be treated as unverified rather than dead.

description: Attempted the obvious Slovenian press-release path on the Halcom corporate site, https://www.halcom.com/sl/novice/ — returned HTTP 404. Halcom articles do exist directly under /sl/<slug>/ (e.g. the 30-years anniversary piece), so the news index lives at some other path.

result.result_summary: 404 on the guessed news index; individual article URLs confirmed to exist under /sl/. This is an unverified path hypothesis, not evidence the section is dead.

why_it_matters: Halcom is the single most important e-banking vendor in the cell; the collector needs the correct news index (via sitemap.xml or on-site navigation) before any automated monitoring is set up.

description: The seed-named vendor 'Result d.o.o.' could not be resolved to a banking-technology supplier. Slovenian-language searching returned only unrelated banking pages; 'result' is a highly noisy term in both sl and en.

result.result_summary: No vendor website, reference page or bank project attributable to a 'Result d.o.o.' in Slovenian banking IT was found.

why_it_matters: Either the actor name is imprecise, refers to a foreign entity (e.g. Result d.o.o. in Croatia/Serbia), or it has been renamed/absorbed. It must be resolved via AJPES/Bizi entity search before further scouting, and treated as a noisy term.

description: Searches in Slovenian for ATM supplier contracts (NCR, Diebold Nixdorf, Wincor Nixdorf) with Slovenian banks produced no contract announcements, only general market descriptions (three ATM brands present: Wincor Nixdorf, NCR, Diebold) and one Wikipedia/hobby page.

result.result_summary: No press release or contract notice naming a Slovenian bank's ATM supplier was located.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: hardware supply to private Slovenian banks is entirely undisclosed. Vendor-side signals (installer/maintainer job ads, Euronet/Payten pages, Diebold SEC filings, ATM chassis branding in bank photos) will have to substitute for contract records.

description: Mikrografija's references page was fetched in full: it carries short logo testimonials only (Delavska hranilnica is the sole financial-sector name), not case studies with dates, scope or values.

result.result_summary: One usable bank-vendor pairing; no project detail, no dates.

why_it_matters: Sets expectations for a whole class of small Slovenian vendors: reference pages yield the 'who', almost never the 'what/when/how much'. Depth must come from the press wire or trade press.

description: No Slovenian-language corporate or reference presence was located for Endava in the Slovenian banking context; the local-language query returned only OTP/NKBM merger coverage. Slovenian-language search terms for 'nearshore delivery centre' style SI vendors were not productive.

result.result_summary: Endava's Slovenian banking footprint remains unevidenced in this pass.

why_it_matters: The seed named Endava/local SIs; either they operate through regional (RO/RS/HR) entities with English-only communications, or they are not materially present in SI banking. Needs an en-language pass against endava.com client stories filtered for Slovenia.

description: The English-language generic query for Slovenian core-banking customer references returned only global vendor listicles (Temenos, Mambu, Thought Machine, FIS, Finastra, Oracle FLEXCUBE) and SEO comparison blogs with zero Slovenian content.

result.result_summary: English-only search is structurally unable to reach this cell; the Slovenian query for the identical concept immediately surfaced HRC/Hibis and the Deželna banka migration.

why_it_matters: Empirically confirms that local-language search is mandatory here, and that English-language listicle domains should be down-weighted or blocked in the collector to avoid SEO noise.

description: Searched for a dedicated public-procurement section on Banka Slovenije's own site (bsi.si) in Slovenian.

result.result_summary: No standalone 'javna naročila' section surfaced on bsi.si; the FOI catalogue indicates all procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si instead. Only a numismatic products invitation was found on bsi.si itself.

why_it_matters: Confirms the collector must treat enarocanje.si/TED as the single route for central-bank tenders rather than expecting an issuer-side feed.

description: Searched in both sl and en for concrete Slovenian contract-award notices for banking/payment-system services or payment terminals.

result.result_summary: Search-engine results returned only portal-level and legal/explanatory pages, no individual banking or payments award notice. Notice-level detail appears to live behind the portals' own search forms, which general web search does not index well.

why_it_matters: Signals that keyword web search is inadequate for this cell — collection must go through the portals' native search/API (enarocanje.si forms, e-JN listing, TED Search API with CPV filters), not through search engines.

description: Looked for a public, bulk-exportable interface to UJP JN Plačila (statutory monthly reporting of executed public-procurement payments since 1 Jan 2023).

result.result_summary: Two entry points found (jnplacila.ujp.gov.si and jnplacila.si) but whether a public search/export exists for third parties, versus authority-only login, was not established in this pass.

why_it_matters: This is potentially the single richest quantitative feed in the cell; its access mode must be resolved before the collection design is fixed. Not recorded as unavailable — only as unverified.

description: KPK press release regarding data quality in the relaunched Erar application.

result.result_summary: KPK publicly stated it had not been informed of incorrect data in the UJP database before the new Erar went live.

why_it_matters: Erar figures for public-sector payments should be treated as indicative and cross-checked against UJP JN Plačila or the underlying contract before any number is quoted as fact.

description: Checked whether state-owned commercial banking stakes give a separate procurement route.

result.result_summary: SDH reports on state capital investments in aggregate; individual portfolio banks are private-law entities whose procurement is generally not on the public portal unless they qualify as contracting authorities. No portal-side evidence found either way in this pass.

why_it_matters: Prevents the collector from assuming state-linked commercial banks will appear as naročniki on enarocanje.si; their signal must come from the private-bank cell instead, with SDH as the ownership bridge.

description: No dedicated Slovenian fintech or payments-industry association was found. Searches in Slovene for a 'slovensko fintech združenje' / 'združenje za plačilne storitve' returned only blockchain/crypto bodies (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SBCA, Blockchain Think Tank Slovenija) and general chambers.

result.result_summary: Slovenia appears to lack a standalone fintech/PSP trade association; the function is split between ZBS (banks), GZS/ZIT (ICT vendors) and DLT communities.

why_it_matters: Analysts should not expect a single fintech member directory for SI; PSP/EMI population must be reconstructed from the Banka Slovenije register plus GZS/ZIT member lists.

description: Bančni vestnik full texts sit behind a login ('Prijava') and a password-protected e-archive; only metadata, article titles and some legacy items appear openly reachable.

result.result_summary: Journal is high value but gated; open crawling would capture only TOC-level data.

why_it_matters: Budget for a subscription or library access, or the richest SI-language banking commentary layer stays out of reach.

description: Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije places its substantive trade-legislation and T-Informacije content in a member-only area (a registration/firewall path was visible in results).

result.result_summary: Merchant-side positions on card fees are likely produced but not publicly readable.

why_it_matters: The acquiring/interchange debate from the merchant perspective may be systematically under-collected without membership.

description: The ZBS members page renders members as logo images and, on fetch, showed no per-member hyperlinks; the transcribed names included at least one likely OCR/rendering artefact ('Lonza Bank', not a known Slovenian bank).

result.result_summary: Member names cannot be reliably extracted from that page alone.

why_it_matters: Any actor list derived from this page must be reconciled against the Banka Slovenije supervised-entity register before use; unreconciled names risk fabricated actors.

description: GZS/ZIT membership page and the GZS member register were identified by URL but their actual member enumerations were not read in this pass; ZIT board composition was only partially visible via search snippets (and the leadership names surfaced were dated ~2019).

result.result_summary: Vendor-side membership data is located but not yet extracted or date-verified.

why_it_matters: Vendor mapping for the SI market remains incomplete until those pages are fetched directly.

description: No evidence was found of an RSS/Atom feed or machine-readable API on any of the association sites examined (ZBS, GZS, TZS); the ZBS press listing offers only category and year filters.

result.result_summary: Collection will have to rely on HTML crawling rather than feeds.

why_it_matters: Affects collector design and polling cost for the A1 workstream.

description: Slovene-language searching for press reports of banks selecting IT/payments vendors ('banka izbrala ponudnika informacijske rešitve', 'javno naročilo') returned no journalistic article naming a bank-vendor award; results drifted to Banka Slovenije corporate pages and the e-JN procurement portal.

result.result_summary: Zero press hits; procurement portal ejn.gov.si surfaced instead as a non-press primary route.

why_it_matters: Vendor-selection intelligence for this cell may be structurally weak — commercial banks are not contracting authorities under public-procurement law, so awards are not gazetted and the press only reports them when a vendor issues a PR. Expect to rely on vendor press releases and Monitor.si rather than daily press.

description: The two highest-value outlets in this cell — Finance.si and the STA wire — are both subscription-gated, and Bančni vestnik full issues sit behind a login ('Prijava' appears in page titles).

result.result_summary: Headline/teaser layers appear public; full text is not.

why_it_matters: A collection design based purely on open crawling will capture the existence of stories but not their specifics, which is exactly where this cell's value lies. Budget for licences or plan a headline-trigger + manual-read workflow.

description: Section URLs for Dnevnik's business desk (https://www.dnevnik.si/posel) and the STAkrog portal (https://krog.sta.si/) were inferred from search-result descriptions rather than confirmed by fetch.

result.result_summary: Outlet existence is well evidenced; exact slugs are not.

why_it_matters: A crawler seeded with an unconfirmed slug will silently return nothing; these two need slug resolution in the verification pass before they count as covered.

description: Slovene banking queries repeatedly pull Banka Slovenije, ECB and even Slovak (National Bank of Slovakia) results — the SI/SK confusion is a persistent noise source in English-language querying.

result.result_summary: Multiple searches returned Slovakia-related entities and central-bank pages instead of press coverage.

why_it_matters: Query design must anchor on Slovene-language tokens and .si domains; English 'Slovenia bank' queries are unreliable and cross-contaminate with Slovakia.
